messages:
Manu: Hey team — need to swap my overnight primary tonight (11pm-7am). I'm on call but need to step away 2-4am for a family thing. Can someone pick up primary between 01:30-04:30 UTC? Important: make sure PD, AWS console access and Grafana perms are in place before the swap.

Sara: I can cover but I don't have the Grafana org Admin role for the prod org. I can take PD though.

Ben R: I can cover the middle chunk (02:00-05:00 UTC). Manu, can you list the quick runbook links + the bridge url? Also confirm whether EU customers are impacted so I can check the EU GPU fleet dashboards.

Manu: Bridge is https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/123-456 (ops bridge). Runbooks: ops-runbook-bot linked these earlier but main ones: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/production-incident and https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/gpu-fleet. Incident-bot: please post the current primary/secondary rotation.

incident-bot: Current rotation: primary=Manu, secondary=Kai. PagerDuty escalation policy: Prod-High (esc -> oncall primary -> secondary -> eng-sre).

Kai: Manu — I can be on standby as secondary. But I do not have the cross-account role for AWS prod:arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/RedwoodOncallRole. I only have read-only. I'll need the role attached or an STS session created for me.

ops-runbook-bot: Grafana group required for oncall: "redwood-oncall-prod" (view+alert-silence). PagerDuty role required: "Responder" in Prod schedule. AWS required: AssumeRole to RedwoodOncallRole with MFA.

Lina: I added Ben R to the PagerDuty prod schedule and gave Sara Responder. Confirmed via PD UI. Screenshots: (uploaded).

Sara: Thanks Lina. Manu, do we need any special KMS/HSM console access tonight for the private endpoints or can that be escalated to Platform SRE if needed?

Manu: No KMS changes expected. If anything hits KMS, escalate to Platform SRE (pager: platform-sre). Primary actions tonight: 1) triage errors from the hosted API, 2) check model-serving latency (>200ms trigger), 3) verify no customer-facing errors on EU region.

Ben R: Grafana — got invited to org but I cannot see the prod-cluster dashboards (403). What permission is missing?

Kai: Likely missing "dashboard.view" in the org role. Manu, can you ask infra to add the Grafana role: "viewer-prod-dash" for Ben? I can also jump in if they need to do an Okta/SCIM sync.

Manu: Pinging infra now. Quick check commands for anyone taking over:

```bash
# PD status
pd schedule show prod-oncall
# AWS assume role (must do MFA)
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/RedwoodOncallRole --role-session-name oncall-session --serial-number arn:aws:iam::999999999999:mfa/username --token-code 123456
# Grafana membership (internal admin)
# (ask infra to run 'grafana-cli org users list 1' if you need confirmation)
```

Infra (via ops channel): Manu — confirmed, added Ben to viewer-prod-dash, and granted Kai assume-role for RedwoodOncallRole. Changes will take up to 60s to propagate.

Lina: PD shows Ben and Sara as active responders now. Ben — try triggering a test alert (non-customer facing) to confirm you get paged.

Ben R: Test alert triggered — I got the PD push, web UI shows me as responding. Grafana dashboards are visible now. :thumbsup:

Sara: I confirmed I can silence alerts from Grafana and view the prod APIs dashboard. I do not yet have AWS assume-role — will need to use Kai or Platform SRE if we need console-level access.

Manu: Great — plan: Ben covers 02:00-05:00 UTC primary, Sara covers 01:30-02:00 and 05:00-06:30 UTC as overlap, Kai stays secondary. I'll formally swap in PD at 01:20 UTC and post here when I hand over. If anyone sees gaps, call out now.

Kai: Noting a possible coverage gap 05:00-05:30 UTC if Ben signs out early. Recommend we keep an explicit check-in at 04:50 UTC.

Manu: Agreed. I'll set a 04:50 reminder and post a handback note. Also: for customer impact assessment, if we see >1% error rate sustained for 10 minutes, treat as P1 and notify support@redwood.ai and the customer success lead. Use the template in the runbook.

Sara: Copy. Small suggestion — can we add a one-line checklist to the runbook for "swap readiness"? items: PD responder confirmed, Grafana dashboards visible, assume-role tested (or secondary available). I can PR that after the shift.

Manu: Please do — that would help future swaps. Handing over in 10m. I'll post "handover: complete" when PD rotation is changed.

incident-bot: Reminder — if you accept primary, annotate the runbook with start/end times and all commands executed during incidents for postmortem.

Manu: handing over: complete. PD now shows Ben R as primary for 02:00-05:00 UTC, Sara as overlap responder. Bridge unlocked. Thanks all :party-parrot:"
